title: BridJet
tagline: Build once, run across all blockchains with a simple off-chain adaptive layer.
description:
Bridjet is a universal off-chain development layer designed to unify the fragmented Web3 landscape. Today, each blockchain operates with its own tools, formats, and rules, forcing developers to rebuild the same product multiple times to reach different ecosystems. This process is slow, costly, and the primary reason over 90% of Web3 projects never move beyond a prototype. Bridjet solves this by providing a single standardized way to build decentralized applications. Developers write their logic once, integrate Bridjet, choose the components they want, and can start signing transactions seamlessly across multiple blockchains.

Technically, Bridjet acts as an adaptation layer: it takes one universal codebase and prepares it so it can operate natively on any blockchain. No translation layers on-chain, no additional infrastructure, and no duplicated versions. Everything runs off-chain, making adoption frictionless.

Unlike other solutions, Bridjet does not try to create its own ecosystem. Instead, it connects existing ones. The SDK is free and open, allowing teams to adopt it without commitment or lock-in. Around this core, Bridjet offers optional tools—such as a unified cross-chain wallet, multi-network analytics, and hosting for interoperable applications. These services accelerate growth but remain completely optional.

This model scales naturally: as more developers adopt the SDK, the industry benefits from real interoperability, and teams gain the ability to reach users across networks with a single build. Bridjet brings simplicity, scalability, and accessibility to Web3. Program once. Run everywhere.
how_its_made: Bridjet is built as an off-chain adaptive layer that standardizes app logic into a universal format. We use TypeScript and Rust modules to create a stable core, and chain-specific adapters handle RPCs, signing flows, and transaction structures for each network. The system takes a single codebase, applies our standardized schema, and adapts it to any blockchain without translation on-chain or duplicated contracts. This architecture lets developers build once, integrate Bridjet, choose components, and sign transactions across ecosystems effortlessly. Our approach is modular, lightweight, and completely non-invasive, making it compatible with any chain or partner tooling.
